name: Ibara (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Ibara city emblem in white: an outlined lozenge with four discs enclosing a ring with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Ibara, a city in Okayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in December 1953.

features.role: Ibara city emblem — an outlined lozenge with four discs enclosing a ring with a stylised character
